title: Escali Primo Digital Food Scale Multi-Functional Kitchen Scale and Baking Scale for Precise Weight Measuring and Portion Control, 8.5 x 6 x 1.5 inches, Chrome
description:
About this item
The Escali Primo Digital Food Scale is multifunctional and feature an easy to use two-button operation; Sealed control panel and rounded design make this digital kitchen scale easy to keep clean and very durable
Simple two-button operation ensure the cooking scale is easy to operate and ensures quick and efficient use; Display and controls are sealed under a protective shield to guard against accidental spills
Tare feature lets you to reset the food scale to zero weight to measure multiple items or subtract the weight of container; Automatic shut-off feature will turn the baking scale off four minutes of inactivity to help conserve and extend battery life
Digital kitchen scale is (8.5 x 6 x 1.5 in) has a capacity of 11 lb (5,000 g) and provides weight readings in 0.05 oz (1 g) increments using the following units: oz, lb:oz, g
Available in a wide selection of fun, playful colors; Lifetime warranty
reviews_5s: Great little portable food scale. 3 weight measuring functions; I only use 1: Ounces. There's also Grams and 1 other. I don't remember what, but I never use that one. It's not high tech. It's for small things. If you want to weigh a large bowl or large something, the display is easily blocked by the thing on the scale... but it's cheap enough that it's not a big deal.I guess it is time to review this thing. I got mine in 2007. I'm about to buy another. The Gram/Oz button eventually got really finicky, and I lost the back battery plate. Technically, I don't need to replace it, but that finicky button drives me mad. But come on, it's been with me 18 years! Essential for meal prep and baking, I also use it for soap making. Not that great if you need to measure 4g of salt, or 2g of baking soda, it can fluctuate a little bit. It's a great size, fits in the back of my silverware drawer. Very light weight. Easy to read display. I really can't complain. It also doesn't drain batteries that much as it auto-shuts off. I think I've changed the batteries maybe twice?I have this for a few months. I purchased this model based on the review and recommendation in Consumer Reports. It is very accurate even measuring just one gram. So great for measuring even very small amounts. When I first opened the package, i was disappointed because it looked really tiny, compared to my older one. But amazingly, the structure is such that I have no problem measuring vegetables which are 1-2 lbs. Most of the time i am able to place vegetables on the weighing plate and still easily able to visualize the display.Works great for my needs (baking).Using it everyday for over a year!Love this! Just started making bagels and it was a lifesaver!Haven’t used it yet but all the functions works according to the instructions during a test run. I am definitely going to like my new when I use it soon.Easy to use, light and not too big. Seems accurate to me.The food scale is not stainless steel but they both work greatused for bread machine once. not better than cup and spoon measurements, but maybe better for other recipes easy to use.
reviews_1s:
I bought this because it was highly reviewed by different online sites. They must have received a different scale, because the one that arrived at my house looked like cheap junk. However, I have many things that look cheap but work well, so it didn't faze me. Turns out its appearance reflects its quality. From the start, it was reading error messages. The only way I could get it to work was to take out the batteries, put them back in, and pray. After doing this a half dozen times, it would finally work long enough to measure some flour. Strangely, it never once worked with the battery cover on. I kept it for three months, hoping it might magically get better. It got worse. I finally threw it away and bought one that costs the same, looks better, and actually worked out of the box (I also compared them - they measured objects the same).I purchased this item, in White, in late February 2021. Upon unboxing it at home, I installed the batteries and confirmed that the scale worked. I then stored the scale in a cool, dry closet in my home, as I only need to use the scale a couple times per month to weigh dry chemicals (such as Baking Soda) to add to my swimming pool. A few weeks later, I used the scale, and it functioned properly without issue. After again storing the scale in an indoor closet for another few weeks, I again used the scale without any problems. Finally, in late April, after storing for another few weeks in an indoor closet, I tried to use the scale for only the third time, and it did not work. The scale has been handled with care and stored appropriately, and I never tried to weigh anything more than four pounds on it. I never tried to weigh any liquids on the scale, and I have never spilled anything on the scale or otherwise allowed it to become soiled. The scale will power up, but then it immediately starts ticking up one gram at a time though nothing is on it, more like a timer than a scale. When an item is placed on it, nothing happens. The scale just keeps ticking up, one gram at a time. I have tried resetting the scale by removing and reinstalling the batteries, but that has not worked. Essentially, this scale worked just beyond the return window, and now I am apparently without recourse with Amazon and needing a new scale. (In fairness, I should note that I have owned this same scale model in Blue since July 2020, also purchased from Amazon. I use that blue scale multiple times per day as a kitchen scale, stored in a kitchen drawer, and I have been pleased with it. If I could write a separate review for that blue scale (Amazon apparently will not allow it), I would give it four stars. However, I wish I could give the White scale zero stars, and the fact that I have purchased two scales and one is completely useless after only two successful weighs, I cannot bring myself to award more than one star unless Amazon replaces the completely nonfunctioning White scale.)Maybe I'm being harsh, but this is not red, it's an ugly flat burgundy. I am extremely disappointed with this. I was going to get the silver one because it's the default option, but I saw the red scale and it looked so cute and happy I decided to get it instead. As for the functionality of the scale, I tried a few items and it seems accurate enough. I'm still giving it 1 star because honestly I'm getting tired of receiving items that look nothing like the photo.This is the worst food scale I have ever had. Biggest issue: not accurate. I can keep adding food and it doesn't register until it is a complete ounce more. Also, when I am trying to portion out food into 2 equal lunches , I weigh the entire product, divide by 2, and then portion out each lunch using the scale to the correct weight. When done I can tell just by looking at the 2 lunches that they are Not equal. I would be better off just dividing equally entirely by my sight than trying to use this scale. I also do not like that you have to hold the off button for 3 seconds for it to turn off. Again, if you want accuracy, don't waste your money with this scale. I would return if I could but I am going to try the Nicewell scale. Take a look at it!Can I give zero stars. This item is a POS. It worked fine for just about 6 months and then just completely went south. I have a health issue so I need to weight things precisely. I love trying to weigh, say 50 grams of rice, and you look at the readout and it says 52 grams, then it says 60 grams, then it says 38 grams , then it say 56 grams. All without touching a thing. Lovely. Great work guys. If you want a scale that will last you less than 6 months, buy this one. You will not be disappointed. Please see picture of an Escali scale properly serviced.very cheap plastic scale does not work only rounds up to the nearest gram , pretty color but is worthless in the kitchen , don't buy don't say i did't warn youPurchased this scale Mar 3, 2025, it's now Apr 19 2025 - scale doesn't work. Power it on and the number scroll. Changed batteries and same thing. I do not place anything on this scale when not in use - no reason for this to happenBeing one of the more affordable scales available, I was not expecting it to be fancy or even built sturdy like a tank. I wanted an affordable scale that was easy to use, fairly accurate, had the minimum amount of features I needed, and had a relatively good amount of positive reviews, not just on Amazon but on other sites as well. This Escali scale seemed to fit the bill.

I think this scale would have worked for me if it had just tared properly and consistently, as well as maintained a reliably accurate reading. The weight shown on the panel would fluctuate anywhere between +/- 1g (which I could possibly live with) or +4-10 grams (which I could not live with) -- and all this would happen with or without something on it.

I am not sure if I am one of the few unlucky ones who received a "dud" or if it had something to do with the item being poorly packed in the Amazon box it came in. The box was a proper size for it, but it lacked enough air pillows to cushion it from moving around. You could hear it sliding around even when you carefully handled the Amazon box. It came with three air pillows only, and 2 out of the 3 did NOT contain any air. Considering that the user manual cautions that the item should not be vibrated or shaken about, I did not feel confident there wasn't anything wrong with the scale.

Some notes that might be helpful to others:
-It's made in China (I wasn't expecting anything different considering the price)
-It's pretty much all plastic, including the silver-looking panel that could be mistaken for metal
-The green color is actually more of a light olive than what's shown in the picture

All in all, I'm pretty disappointed that I have to return it. I'm not sure if I would give it another chance by getting another one. I saw a review on here that says it's worth double the money. Even if it did work properly for me, I honestly don't think it would be worth $50!The scale was great for four months, but now it just cycles through random numbers when I put a weight on it above ten grams or so. Watch out.The power-off timer on this scale does NOT reset based on changes in weight, which means that if you buy it to make pour-over coffee you will likely end up with the scale powering off in the middle of the brew. Horrible timer design.
